author: j. m. jamison
title: Austin ISD to retake control of Mendez Middle School after improvement under charter partner - Austin Journal
text:
Austin Independent School District (Austin ISD) will resume management of Mendez Middle School starting with the 2026-27 academic year. The decision follows the school’s achievement of a B rating under the operation of Third Future Schools, an 1882 charter partner that has managed the campus since 2022.
Mendez Middle School had been operated by outside partners since the 2014-15 school year due to repeated unacceptable ratings. Third Future Schools took over in 2022 and committed to improving the school’s performance to a B rating by the 2024-25 school year, a goal reached this year. District leaders say this progress makes it an appropriate time for Austin ISD to take back responsibility.
The Mendez campus also houses the Alternative Learning Center (ALC). District officials are considering new permanent locations for the ALC and plan to consult with the community before making a final decision.
For the remainder of this school year, Third Future Schools will continue managing Mendez as planned. In August 2026, Austin ISD will assume responsibility for academics, operations, staffing, and campus leadership at Mendez. The district aims to maintain and build on recent improvements.
Families assigned to Mendez have received direct communication about these changes along with a survey regarding future plans for the school. Austin ISD will hold community engagement meetings to discuss academic programs, extracurricular activities, and special offerings at Mendez.
Austin ISD serves more than 72,000 students across 116 schools and employs over 5,000 classroom teachers. The district provides education in more than 100 languages and maintains a graduation rate of 93.3 percent according to its official website. It is one of Texas’ eight largest public school districts and focuses on partnering with families and communities to prepare students for college, careers, and life (source).
